title: Health
summary: Says whether the console and each module are answering right now, and which edition this kit is.

surfaces.web: N/A(web parity is decided in WO-0002)

notes: M1: no route yet, and that is deliberate. /api/health is a kernel route whose payload needs the live brain/engine/registry state (STATE, TOKEN, reg_load); re-implementing it inside an adapter would duplicate kernel logic, which this work order forbids. The route transfers once the kernel exposes a health_payload() function (Phase M3, in its own work order). Until then this module owns the *status answer* /api/modules reports and the kernel keeps serving /api/health byte-for-byte. Read-only: owns no state.
